description:
Power draw of a set of components, and what runs it. The electricity calculator page's math. `total_draw` is the summed power; `supply` says how many of each
power source covers it at its best output (`needed`); `batteries` gives each battery's `runtime_minutes` on a
full charge, or `enough_output: false` when the load is above what that battery can deliver.

components.description: Comma-separated `shortname:quantity` pairs (display names work too; quantity defaults to 1). Components by shortname or name from /calculators/electricity.

name: calculate_power
title: Power draw of a set of components, and what runs it
